title: Denodo
summary:
Denodo Technologies is a software company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with offices in A Coruna and Madrid (Spain), London (UK), New York City, Chicago, Boise (USA), Munich (Germany), and Chennai (India). The company specializes in data virtualization, a modern data integration strategy in which users can integrate data without replicating it.

Denodo was founded in 1999 by Angel Vina, who was then a professor at the University of A Coruna. He recognized that data repositories were likely to grow unsustainably large if businesses continued to integrate data in the traditional manner and envisioned a data integration strategy based on data virtualization. The initial research at Universidad de A Coruna focused on extracting data from web sites designed for human browsing rather than automated data extraction.

The company's core product is the Denodo Platform, an award-winning data integration, management, and delivery platform using a logical approach to enable self-service BI, advanced analytics, hybrid and multi-cloud integration, and enterprise data services. Angel Vina realized that innovations developed for web site data extraction could also be applied to the many different data sources being used within large organizations.

Denodo receives funding from ROSP Coruna, a private equity firm owned by one of the founders of Inditex (parent company of Zara), and HGGC also made an investment. Denodo has been recognized as a Leader in both Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools and The Forrester Wave: Enterprise Data Fabric. The platform has been deployed across biotech, energy, financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, pharma, public sector, retail, technology, and telecommunication industries.
